title: Lesson 6: Choosing Models & Providers: Capability Tiers, Routing, and Fallbacks
description: The biggest agent-ops mistake is picking one 'best' model and pointing everything at it. This lesson builds the three-tier capability model, the three jobs of a router, and the fallback chains that keep agents alive when providers fail.
